title: Zhi-Ting Xu
text:
Welcome! I am Zhi-Ting Xu (許至廷), an Assistant Professor in the Department of Finance at National Chung Cheng University, Taiwan.
As a researcher and educator, my work lies at the intersection of AI in finance, asset pricing, and behavioral finance. Specifically, my research investigates investor recognition, information asymmetry, and the implications of ownership dynamics on risk-sharing and market outcomes. I am also keenly interested in leveraging data-driven approaches, including machine learning and text analytics, to understand market anomalies.
This website serves as a portfolio of my academic journey. Here you can explore my latest research and access my teaching information.
Feel free to connect with me for potential collaborations or academic discussions!
